messages.content: 你能幫我找到紐約有閱讀室和小說區的公共圖書館，然後在洛杉磯有Wi-Fi和有兒童區的公共圖書館，最後在芝加哥有咖啡廳和閱讀室的公共圖書館嗎？

function.description: Locate nearby public libraries based on specific criteria like English fiction availability and Wi-Fi. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

message.reasoning:
The user wants to find public libraries in three cities with certain facilities. They want:

1. In New York (NY), libraries with Reading Room and Fiction section.
2. In Los Angeles (LA), libraries with Wi-Fi and Children Section.
3. In Chicago, libraries with Cafe and Reading Room.

We need to call the function public_library_find_nearby for each location with appropriate facilities. The function signature expects location string and facilities which can be one of the enumerated values: "Wi-Fi" | "Reading Room" | "Fiction" | "Children Section" | "Cafe". But the facilities parameter seems to accept only one value? It says "Facilities and sections in public library." It might accept an array? The type says "facilities: "Wi-Fi" | "Reading Room" | "Fiction" | "Children Section" | "Cafe"[]". That suggests it could be either a single string or an array of strings. So we can pass an array of strings.

Thus we need to call the function three times. We should do them sequentially. We'll produce calls to the function. The assistant should output the function calls.
